preconditions.description: The number of names must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 100 for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name must have a length between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or len(stdout) == 26 and all(c in stdout for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, output must be a permutation of 'a'-'z'; otherwise, output 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: any(name[i] < name[i+1] for i in range(n-1) for name in names)
postconditions.description: The output order must ensure that the names are sorted lexicographically according to the modified alphabet.
